name: Ohitsujinomiya Arilus
source:
A quick mover! Pure of heart! That’s Prince Aries.

As pure as a spring lamb, he is a man of action who keeps moving forward, following where his curiosity leads. He’s an impulsive buyer and has been having money troubles since he came to Earth. He’s a bad liar and has an honest heart, so the other princes sometimes deceive him. He is cheerful and positive, but has a surprisingly soft side.
